hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Nvidia is the central bet on generative-AI compute infrastructure - not 'selling GPUs' but being the STRUCTURAL BOTTLENECK of the largest capital-investment cycle in recent history (Data Center 75.2bn of 81.6bn Q1 FY27 revenue, +92% YoY; revenue 8x in four fiscal years). Q2 FY27 guided ~91bn EXCLUDING China - any H200 unblocking is free optionality, integrated only on OFFICIAL confirmation. The report lands 26/08/2026.

== THESIS READ ==
- The 91bn Q2 bar (ex-China) is the imminent test; the model's FY27 (+81% revenue) leans on the guided ramp plus Rubin cycle. Watch: 26/08 print and whether China stays excluded from the next guide.
- Deceleration is MODELED, not feared: FY29-31 growth fades from +36% to +14% with margin easing - the thesis survives normalization. Watch: hyperscaler capex plans as the leading indicator.
- GAAP/non-GAAP convergence (SBC no longer excluded from Q1 FY27) can blur consensus comparisons still in the old format. Watch: basis labels on every consensus snapshot.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Fiscal year ends late January: 'data' FY26 = year ended Jan 2026; horizon FY27-FY31. Published FY26 ETR ~9.7% (FDII/R&D credits) vs 17% normative - +5.1bn residual documented, not reconducted. Bridge finNet flat +2.5bn (embedded in the fiche's conversion) - conservative vs the 90-to-320bn cash build, flagged to steepen. dernierCall absent (to initialize at the 26/08 report). priorEPS null (young fiche).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
FY27: revenue 391bn, EBIT 262.8bn (67.2%), EPS 9.10 (consensus-aligned); FY28-FY31: growth +41/+36/+24/+14%, EBIT margin easing 68 -> 70 -> ~70%, ETR 17%, shares -1.6%/yr. Watch: 26/08 report (dernierCall init + first gH archive); China policy; networking attach rates; custom-ASIC competitive encroachment (AVGO).

== CATALYSTS ==
Q2 FY27 report (26/08/2026 - next week); Rubin launch cadence; China H200 official decision; hyperscaler 2027 capex frames.

ancrages.moteur: Guidance officielle T2 FY27 (91 Md$ de CA +/-2%, marge brute ~75%, opex ~8.3-8.5 Md$), qui ancre le point de depart du consensus FY27 et exclut explicitement tout CA Data Center Chine.

Consensus sell-side recoupe (Seeking Alpha, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, BofA) pour l'EPS FY27 (~9.10$) et FY28 (~13.20$), utilise comme ancrage direct plutot qu'un retrofit CA->EBIT->Net bottom-up, compte tenu de l'ampleur des incertitudes sur le mix Data Center/Networking a cet horizon.

Extrapolation d'un ralentissement progressif du taux de croissance de l'EPS (de +45% FY28 vers +17% FY31) au-dela de l'horizon consensus fiable (FY27-28), par simple loi des grands nombres - aucune source specifique au-dela de FY28/29, confiance nettement plus faible.
Expansion de la marge EBIT vers 67-70% d'ici FY27-31, portee par un opex croissant nettement plus lentement que le CA (comme observe FY25->FY26 : opex +40% vs CA +65%), plafonnee a 70% par prudence.
Taux d'imposition normatif de 17%, au milieu de la fourchette de guidance officielle FY27 (16-18%), reconduit par simplification sur tout l'horizon de projection.

Autorisation de rachat de 80 Md$ approuvee le 18/05/2026 (en sus des 38.5 Md$ restants) et politique de retour d'environ 50% du free cash flow, traduites en decroissance moderee du nombre d'actions diluees (~-1.7%/an en moyenne) sur l'horizon de projection.

Le free cash flow genere depasse tres largement les 50% verses aux actionnaires et le capex, ce qui continue a faire croitre la tresorerie nette (cash+placements moins dette) meme apres rachats/dividendes.

Projected finNet is a FLAT +2.5bn embedded in the fiche's conversion - conservative vs the growing cash pile (90 -> 320bn), to steepen at a future refresh.
